scope: Original prompt sections 3 and 10: job deadline enforcement while paused
method: Real isolated backend and browser worker processes. After a pending approval or takeover, backdate only the synthetic job started_at beyond its 120-second budget; allow two seconds of worker polling.
expected: Expired jobs transition to a terminal failure rather than retaining the desktop job indefinitely.
impact: Deadline handling is inconsistent during pauses. This repro establishes a stuck running job, not an unauthorized desktop action.

correction.implementation: Worker checks the existing server authority and total job deadline on every claimed-job polling cycle, before adapter initialization, graph resumption, or staff waiting.
correction.policy: Total elapsed time includes staff waiting. An offline worker checks expiry when it reconnects.
assertions: Terminal failure with budget error and end time
